--- title: "Data and coverage" --- Season = the calendar year a season ends (NBA 2026 = 2025-26). ## Which seasons each analysis uses The NBA team and championship analysis starts in 2005-06, the first season with salaries reported for about 99% of minutes. The WNBA keeps every season from 2009: its salary records only begin in 2021, and starting there would leave just six champions to learn from. | Analysis | Needs | NBA from | WNBA from | |---|---|---|---| | Player archetypes and player impact | box score, play-by-play, lineups | 2003-04 | 2009 | | Team models and championships | the above, from the first season with near-complete salary data (NBA) | 2005-06 | 2009 | | + defensive-type features (rim blocks, steal types) | play-by-play detail | 2006-07 | 2013 | | + creation tags (drives, pull-ups) | play-by-play shot descriptions | 2017-18 | 2019 | | **Salary value** | everything above except creation tags, plus salary and age | **2009-10** | **2021** | | + hustle stats | NBA.com hustle tracking | 2017-18 | not available | ## Shot-zone calibration ESPN's recorded position of layups and dunks drifts between eras: on average about 0.35 ft from the hoop in 2004-10, about 1.6 ft in 2011-17 and 2.3-3.9 ft from 2018, with the WNBA's 2020 bubble season the furthest (3.95 ft). A fixed rim line would count different shots as "rim" in different eras; in 2020 it pushed many WNBA layups into the mid-range. So the rim zone is re-centered each league-season: **rim cutoff = 4 ft + (that season's mean layup/dunk distance - 2 ft)**. This keeps the rim make rate steady across eras and removes the 2020 gap. ```{=html}
``` ## Who counts A player-season is **counted** if the player appeared in at least 15% of team games, or averaged 20+ minutes over at least 6 games (NBA) or 4 games (WNBA), which covers injury-shortened seasons. Uncounted rows stay in the data but do not shape the archetypes, labels or value rankings. Players who were hurt for the playoffs are not counted on their team's playoff roster. | league | player-seasons | not counted | kept by injury rule | likely season-ending | missed playoffs | % minutes not counted | |:---------|-----------------:|--------------:|----------------------:|-----------------------:|------------------:|------------------------:| | NBA | 11500 | 1313 | 77 | 439 | 161 | 0.49 | | WNBA | 2874 | 194 | 6 | 99 | 46 | 0.3 | ## Sources | Data | Source | Use | |---|---|---| | Box scores, play-by-play, schedules | ESPN, via the sportsdataverse data releases | all stats | | NBA salaries 2000-2025 | owner-supplied files; 2025-26 from ESPN's salary list; 2026-27 from Basketball-Reference contracts | salary value | | WNBA salaries 2021-2026 | Her Hoop Stats WNBA Salary Cap Database; gaps filled from Spotrac | salary value | | NBA hustle stats | NBA.com, via the gabriel1200/site_Data mirror | defense checks | | WNBA ages (to 2019) | FiveThirtyEight WNBA-stats (CC BY 4.0) | age | ::: {.caveat} Raw source files are not redistributed here.
